subject: Hausa
examFormat: Two papers. Paper 1 is a 1-hour multiple-choice test for 60 marks in three sections: Language 30 items, Literature 22 items, Culture 8 items. Paper 2 is an essay test in three sections (rubrics in Hausa, official Hausa orthography), 2 hours for 100 marks: six questions (three from Section A, two from Section B, one from Section C). Composition/letter writing carries 25 marks and each of the other five questions 15 marks; maximum 160 marks, scaled down to 100%.
excluded: List of Hausa texts for 2014-2015 and reference texts (set books change; described generically).

topics.name: Composition and Letter Writing (Hausa)
objectives: Write a narrative essay (Insha'i Na Labari)
Write a descriptive essay (Insha'i Na Siffance)
Write an argumentative essay (Insha'i Na Muhawara)
Write an expository essay (Insha'i Na Bayani)
Write a dialogue (Muhawara ta kai tsaye)
Write on a proverb (Karin Magana)
Write a letter (Rubutun Wasika)
topics.content: Candidates are advised to write an essay of about 300 words and spend not more than 45 minutes on this question.

topics.name: Sound System (Tsarin Sauti)
objectives: Describe the production of consonants and vowels in terms of place, manner and status of the glottis, e.g. bilabials, nasals, voiced and voiceless sounds
Describe syllable structure: the way consonants and vowels combine in a syllable
Identify the syllable structures CV (BW), CVV (BWW) and CVC (BWB)
Distinguish open syllables (budaddiyar gaba) from closed syllables (rufaffiyar gaba)
Describe vowel production: short and long vowels and diphthongs
Identify high, low and falling tones
topics.content: Candidates answer one question from the two set. Terms given in Hausa: furucin bakake da wasula da kirar gaba; gurbi da yanayi da matsayin makwallato; tsarin gaba; ire-iren gaba; furucin wasula; karin sauti (karin sautin sama, karin sautin kasa, karin sauti mai faduwa).

topics.name: Grammar (Nahawu)
topics.content: Candidates answer one question from the two set.

subtopics.name: Word Structure and Word Formation (Ginin kalmomi)
objectives: Identify root (saiwa)
Identify affixes (dafi): prefix (dafa goshi), infix (dafa ciki) and suffix (dafa keya)

subtopics.name: Word Classes (Azuzuwan kalmomi)
objectives: Identify noun (suna), verb (aikatau), adjective (sifa), adverb (bayanau), pronoun (wakilin suna) and conjunction (mahadi)
Identify specifier (mafayyaci), quantifier (ma'auni), demonstrative (nunau), ideophone (amsa-kama), diminutive (tsigilau), stabilizer (dirka) and referential (madanganci)

subtopics.name: Grammatical Categories (Rukunonin Nahawu)
objectives: Identify tense and aspect (lokutan aiki): general past, relative past, general continuous, relative continuous, first future, second future, habitual and subjunctive
Identify negative (korewa)
Identify gender (jinsi) and number (adadi)

subtopics.name: Structure and Types of Sentences (Tsari da ire-iren jumloli)
objectives: Identify subject and predicate (yankin suna da na aikatau)
Identify simple (sassaukar jumla), complex (sarkakkiyar jumla) and compound (hardaddiyar jumla) sentences

topics.name: Oral Literature (Hausa)
objectives: Show knowledge of the set books on oral prose (tatsuniya, tarihi, karin magana, ka-cinci-ka-cinci)
Show knowledge of the set books on oral poetry (wakokin baka)
Show knowledge of the set books on oral drama (wasannin gargajiya)
topics.content: Three set books cover the different genres. One question is set on each and candidates answer any one. Section B has six questions in all and candidates answer two: one from Oral and one from Written Literature.

topics.name: Written Literature (Hausa)
objectives: Show knowledge of the set books on written prose (zube), poetry (rubutattun wakoki) and drama (wasan kwaikwayo)
topics.content: Three set books cover the different genres. One question is set on each and candidates answer any one.

topics.name: Culture (Hausa)
topics.content: Two questions are set and candidates answer one. Items include customs and institutions listed in the subtopics.

subtopics.name: Greeting
objectives: Describe gaisuwar ban girma, gaisuwar taya murna, gaisuwar lokatai (safiya, rana, la'asar, damina, rani, d.s.), jaje and ta'aziyya

subtopics.name: Tarbiyya (Upbringing)
objectives: Describe hanyoyin tarbiyya (tsawa, kwabo, harara, horo, d.s.)
Describe girmama iyaye, girmama na gaba, girmama tsara and da'a ga hukuma

subtopics.name: Hospitality (Karimci)
objectives: Describe girmama bako, kyauta, ciyarwa and sadaka

subtopics.name: Family (Iyali)
objectives: Describe al'adun aure, haihuwa, radin suna, reno, yaye, kaciya, zumunci and al'adun mutuwa

subtopics.name: Traditional Beliefs and Practices
objectives: Describe al'adun da suka saba wa addini, e.g. camfi, bori, duba, tsibbu, maita, fatalwa, d.s.

subtopics.name: Traditional Occupations (Sana'o'in gargajiya)
objectives: Describe noma, kira, saka, jima, wanzanci, kitso, sassaka, kiwo, dukanci, fawa, su, rini, kasuwanci and dillanci

subtopics.name: Traditional Medicine (Magungunan gargajiya)
objectives: Identify masu ba da maganin gargajiya, e.g. magori, 'yar maiganye, bokaye, wanzamai, d.s.

subtopics.name: Traditional Authority and Office Holding (Sarautun gargajiya)
objectives: Describe the offices of sarki, hakimi, dagaci, mai unguwa, shamaki, shantali, sarkin zagi, liman, sarkin fada, d.s.

subtopics.name: Forms of Traditional Recreation (Wasannin dandali)
objectives: Describe dambe, kokawa, kalankuwa, shanci, sukuwa and hawan kaho
